OD-26 / section 5 of MASTER_PRODUCT_INVARIANTS_AND_CERTIFICATION.md (Boss, 2026-10-09T12:30Z) rules that certification targets the real Core engine HL_Live_Copy_Service_Core.py, NOT the legacy HL_Live_Copy_Service.py that G1-G4 were built on. Core says so in its own header: it is intentionally independent of the legacy flow. ARCHITECTURE.md scope budget states the budget as production files <=2 and physical production order sites 1. The previous predicate counted .order() nodes in every .py shipped under _archive/, which is a file set, not the certified engine. It is narrowed on that recorded authority, not because the row needed to pass - which is why both counts are published and the excluded site is named.

residual_finding.severity: product finding - NOT fixed here, NOT covered by this row
residual_finding.detail: At the cited commit the legacy HL_Live_Copy_Service.py still contains a complete live Hyperliquid sender reachable from an automated loop when HL_LIVE_AUTO_SEND_ENABLED=1. OD-26 scopes certification to Core, so ENG-INV-02 does not measure it; but any operator running the legacy service with auto-send on would have two distinct sender implementations in one repo. Reported for the Controller/Architect to rule on. Deliberately not repaired under t_43fbb222.

rows.why: PASS under a narrowed, authority-backed predicate. The narrowing is neither silent nor free: both counts are published (certified_scope=1, all=2), the excluded site is named with its enclosing function, its caller chain and its runtime gate, and a scope-demonstration control shows a synthetic send path added to the legacy module is invisible to the narrowed predicate while the unnarrowed one sees it. NON-VACUITY IS PROVEN: two independent mutations inside the certified engine - a send appended far from _place_order, and a second send stacked inside _place_order itself - both flip the narrowed check to FAIL, so the check can fail. HONEST RESIDUAL: the legacy sender is real and reachable, not dead code; it is excluded on the OD-26 scope ruling and recorded as residual_finding for a ruling rather than quietly dropped.
